# teleme.me

> A free, privacy-focused online teleprompter application that runs entirely in the browser. No accounts, no logins, no data collection. Features advanced controls including adjustable speed, mirroring (Picture-in-Picture), customization, and full-screen support.

## Key Features

- **100% Client-Side**: All processing happens in your browser—no server uploads or data collection.
- **No Registration**: Instant access without creating accounts or providing personal information.
- **Professional Controls**: Adjustable scroll speed, markdown rendering, customizable fonts and sizes.
- **Picture-in-Picture Mode**: Read your script in a floating window while using other applications.
- **Pro Recording**: Integrated video capture using AVC3 for robust MP4 exports with **no watermarks**.
- **Multilingual Support**: Available in 11 languages, including English, Spanish, Japanese, Hindi, French, German, Chinese, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian, and Polish.
- **Offline Power (PWA)**: Installable app that works perfectly without internet connection after initial load.
- **Privacy First**: Your camera data and recordings never leave your device.
- **Free Forever**: No premium tiers, subscriptions, watermarks, or hidden costs.

## Use Cases

Perfect for video creators, presenters, journalists, educators, public speakers, content creators, live streamers, and anyone needing a reliable teleprompter without software installation.

## Technical Details

- Pure React implementation with Vite and `vite-plugin-pwa`.
- **Full PWA Support**: Installable on desktop/mobile with a dedicated app icon and offline capabilities.
- Supports keyboard shortcuts: Space (Play/Pause), M (Markdown), P (PiP), C (Controls).
- Responsive design optimized for desktop and mobile.
- Zero cookies or tracking scripts.

## Getting Started

- **General Users**: Visit [teleme.me](https://teleme.me) to start using the teleprompter immediately in your browser.
- **Technical Users**: For local use or offline setups, clone the repository from [GitHub](https://github.com/SomeoneElseSt/teleme.me), install dependencies with `pnpm install`, and run locally with `pnpm run dev`.
